**4.2.0 notes are written.** [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3)

Out of 380 commits, one real feature and one breaking change and ten fixes stood out.

| Type | Count | Highlight |
|---|---|---|
| Breaking | 1 | expired token now returns `401`, not `403` |
| Added | 1 | webhook retries with backoff |
| Fixed | 10 | null cursors, duplicate header, leaked timers, body logging, and more |

Everything else was dependency bumps, renames, and internal refactors, left out.

Next: check the `401` change against any client code expecting `403`.
